payload.text:
ENGINE AUDIT — sofar 0.25.1 with a high-level AI harness (Claude Code), 2026-08-10. Full evidence, one session.

VERDICT: the engine core is production-grade and rigorously verified; the soft edge is not the code but the protocol steps that depend on agent discipline — exactly the gap drift-certification exists to quantify.

1) VERIFICATION SURFACE — excellent. 1447 tests pass, 4 skipped, 0 fail in 6.07s across 86 test files vs ~21.2k LOC of source TS; typecheck and build clean at workspace root. docs/SPEC.md (2497 lines) is authoritative with per-phase acceptance criteria bound to acceptance.phaseN test files; citation integrity is itself test-enforced (citations.test.ts). Latency is a pinned capability, not a hope: every hook shim must complete <100ms end-to-end — spawn, CLI boot, fold, render (speed T2, shim-latency.test.ts).

2) HARNESS INTEGRATION DESIGN — strong and deliberately token-engineered. Five 4-line sh shims (SessionStart/Stop/PostToolUse/SessionEnd/UserPromptSubmit) with all logic in the CLI; SessionStart injects a budgeted <=10k-char status block (goal, constraints-as-guards, progress, rejected approaches, staleness and peer warnings, read-back instruction) that is byte-stable for an unchanged record — prompt-cache friendly by invariant (SPEC §Architectural invariants). Zero model API calls: everything is read-side derivation; only egress is opt-in sync to the user's own repo. 10 MCP tools with typed schema rejection; get_state digest ~1k tok and deliberately NOT called at session start (speed-2 T5a — injection supersedes it). Stop hook gates on measured drift; lazy registration means a do-nothing session leaves no trace; git/sofar commands are self-recording-exempt.

3) ROBUSTNESS AND SECURITY — good. Append-only truth with O_APPEND atomic writes; Phase 1 acceptance proves 1k concurrent appends from 4 processes with zero lost/interleaved lines, corrupt lines skip with warning (never fatal, never rewritten), replay deterministic. Slug traversal defense at two layers (schema boundary + resolved-path containment, security-hardening 1.1); command_run redaction (new events only — security-hardening M1); writeback collisions surfaced via parallel_writebacks reconciliation.

4) LIVE DOGFOODING EVIDENCE — the interesting part. This repo self-hosts: 35 initiatives, 33 at 100% tasks, ~200 logged decisions. sofar doctor on its own repo: 4 FAIL, 147 WARN. All 4 FAILs are session-routing tears — including THIS audit session, caught live: one exploratory ls before `sofar new engine-audit` let lazy registration pin the session to drift-certification, and the re-pin tore it. Diagnostics work; the workflow has a sharp edge (explore-before-deciding tears a session; auto-update M3 documents the footgun but the engine cannot prevent it). The 147 WARNs are mostly discipline debt the engine detects but cannot force closed: stale phases never marked done, promoted memories never hand-copied into repo.md, sessions that touched files but tracked no tasks.

5) THE HEADLINE CLAIM — in progress, honestly handled. <2% drift is a claim under active certification (drift-certification, 12/23 tasks): premise audit found defective traps, historical corpus exhausted at 0.8% survival (592 candidates), instrument re-scoped to authored constraints (scenario 4) with the 5 surviving historical traps as a separately-reported validity anchor. Rigor is exceptional (frozen pre-registrations, blinded cross-family grading, screens-only-tighten law, decision guards) but no certified number exists yet on 0.25.1. session-strategy-bench (20/20) completed the one-long-session vs fresh-sessions-with-sofar comparison with a caveats log.

FLAGS: (a) torn sessions are the top live defect class — 4 of 4 doctor FAILs, natural explore-first workflow is the trigger; (b) 2 sessions did work without write-back despite the Stop gate — headless/crash paths escape enforcement; (c) 147 warnings risks warning blindness — nothing drives hygiene debt to zero; (d) the drift number the product is named for is not yet certified.
